book.title: Luka Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Lukaꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesuꞌa Tahiꞌa 72 Tuḡuziro
Eꞌe enogano, Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa vaze ꞌahoga 72 ohozadu aneꞌa onamihi reiroteꞌe neḡa niduꞌa zu habaꞌa niduꞌa aheuaheu ibite tuḡuziro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Hiriviteꞌe ḡauḡaꞌe ḡehaḡa bagaḡa, rehano gau azaḡaꞌe tahiḡa. Eꞌanoꞌo hiriveꞌeteꞌe Zuhiꞌaḡa Boro mazao gau azaḡa ane mebao tuḡuzoga veize uminoꞌi.
Onamoꞌi. Butu ḡuniḡa boꞌaḡano mamoe tuḡuzeꞌeteꞌe teige, e za agire azaḡa boꞌaḡano tuḡuzeꞌohe.
Hadi niharaḡa ga fuse ga tamaka ago odohoꞌi. Ebu ibio vaze ꞌahoga hidoꞌidene, ani teite faḡa ḡoereꞌenaꞌa, mada ago hauḡoꞌi.
Vaze ꞌahoga ne diuḡoꞌidene, ibite geno ꞌahige roꞌi, 'Badiꞌaꞌa zama roḡeḡa zenoꞌi.'
Ne eꞌe zamaḡano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa zama roḡeḡa urateꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa reine, zaꞌa rateꞌe zama roḡeḡaꞌe ani rana radiꞌuma. U mene reine, zama roḡeḡa eꞌeꞌa zae bare vaḡiꞌuma.
Ne tiba zamaḡano daꞌo radoꞌi, ebu zeḡeꞌa ziniꞌeteꞌe ogomuḡa anoꞌi zu gagoꞌi, mazaḡa gau azaḡaniꞌa gauze naeḡa meꞌuma. Ne ꞌahogaꞌahogano ago ragave onamoꞌi.
Ne ꞌahoga onamadu za mae ḡihizoꞌidene, nagi ogomu ziniꞌeteꞌe anoꞌi.
Ebu eꞌea ugi azaḡa faizadu ꞌahige haramozenoꞌi, 'Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa zae mazao haniteha.'
Rehano ne ꞌahoga onamadu za mene mae ḡihizoꞌidene, ne ibi boro onamoꞌi,
ebu ꞌahige zoꞌi, 'Badiꞌaꞌa zae haḡai sauꞌa ederifine, eme zae haba konoḡa odafeo kadaranateꞌe ꞌada zauhe modadu iḡuneꞌohe. Rehano ederoꞌi, Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa haniteha.'”
Ebu Iesuꞌa bare ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, Badiꞌa kota madaḡano za mene mae ḡihiziroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Sodoma azaḡa ufeta vitize aduga boro hidiꞌuma.
Haḡai Sauꞌanonoꞌo Mene Ḡihureꞌeteꞌe Habaꞌa

“Korasini azaḡa, za aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Betesaida azaḡa, za aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Eḡeꞌa zae mazao haḡairoteꞌe haḡaiḡa gigiꞌaꞌe Turo zu Sidono azaḡa mazao haḡaifone, ze dabuaze ḡuꞌa vidau ehoradu vega vadinizeo ase ḡuzuheꞌenaꞌa, haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo ḡihurifo.
Rehano Badiꞌa kota madaḡano zaꞌe Turo zu Sidono azaḡa ufeta vitize aduga boro hidiꞌuma.
Kaperanauma azaḡa, zaꞌe adureo Badiꞌa habaꞌa tutuze itiꞌuma rae zamareꞌehe? Mene! Zaꞌe rune habaꞌano mae feuziꞌuma.
Za egoziniꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe egoniꞌohe, ebu za hezahoziniꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe hezahoniꞌohe. Ebu eḡe hezahohiꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe Badiꞌaḡa hezahohauꞌohe.”
Iesu Tahiꞌaḡa 72ꞌa Bariro
Ebu Iesu tahiꞌa 72 onamadu Iesu vaḡe barirotene, matuꞌeꞌenaꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eme ḡae niḡano vine sauꞌa hegoze buzirotene, ze emeḡe ḡoere egofiro.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Vazabu agaḡa teige, Sataniꞌa adureonoꞌo ḡarihe fase buauꞌeteꞌe horoniro.
Ḡianoꞌi, e zaeꞌa mohe zu asiasi edeze ruzeꞌeteꞌe zu emeḡe agire Satani gigiꞌaḡa raharahaneꞌeteꞌe inaraḡa ziniro. Ḡau ꞌahoganiꞌa za mene sausauziꞌuma.
Rehano vine sauꞌasauꞌaniꞌa zae ḡoere egoziniꞌeteꞌe uꞌano ago matuꞌoꞌi, rehano zae niꞌe adureo mirihiroteꞌe uꞌano matuꞌoꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa Matuꞌe Kuraro

Eꞌe madaḡano Iesuꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa iriꞌavonadu matuꞌe rudaro, ebu ꞌahige rae reiro, “Mama, ḡaꞌe adure zu raha Zuhiꞌaḡa. E niguꞌeꞌohe, mazaḡa ḡaeꞌa vaze huhuzaḡa zu edeḡa boro azaḡa mazaoꞌe ḡoere huga ꞌahiguḡa ꞌuꞌuru tiro, rehano tahiꞌa komeꞌa teigeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazaoꞌe rae fureniro. Mama, a hube, ꞌouge haḡairotaꞌaꞌe ḡae ura.

Eḡe Mamaꞌa ḡau niduꞌa eḡe iniro. Vazeni ꞌahoga Ubuga aḡuꞌa, rehano Moga daꞌo Ubuga edeḡa. Ebu vazeni ꞌahoga Moga aḡuꞌa, rehano Ubuga daꞌo zu Ubuganiꞌa Moga moneo ihozoga veize ohotiroteꞌe azaḡa daꞌo Moga edeḡa.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa tehe ḡiazadu sifu ziro, “Zaꞌe matuꞌoꞌi, mazaḡa naginiꞌa fureruꞌeteꞌe ubumaze hina horoneꞌohe.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, peroveta azaḡa zu kini azaḡaꞌe zaeꞌa izidi nagini horoneꞌeteꞌe horonihi rae reiro, rehano mene horoniro, ebu zaeꞌa izidi nagini igiꞌeteꞌe igihi rae reiro, rehano mene igiro.”
Samaria Vazeḡa Manoḡa Hari Idaidaḡa
Mada ꞌahogano Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa iḡunadu Iesu tuhune nuroga veize ḡadiniro, “Ihore vazeḡa, e nougine, ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Mose goro ḡoeꞌanoꞌe nouge rae mirihiro? Ḡa nougenouge meꞌode horoneꞌohe?”

Aniꞌa naenaeniro, “Mose goro ḡoeꞌano ꞌahige raꞌohe, 'Zamaḡo niduꞌa hina, vineḡo niduꞌa hina, inaraḡo niduꞌa hina zu zamaroneḡo niduꞌa hina ḡae Badiꞌa Zuhiꞌa Boro zamare borofoꞌi,' ebu 'Ḡa ḡae bare zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe teige, nabugo zamare borofoꞌi.'”
Ebu Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡae naenaeꞌe duduḡa. Ḡa ꞌouge haḡaine, ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma.”
Rehano ani Iesuꞌa ani mazao duduḡa rae rouga uratadu bare ḡadiniro, “Iniuꞌe eḡe nabudi?”

Iesuꞌa ꞌahige naenaeniro, “Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa Ierusalemaonoꞌo Ieriko ovoinu. Ebu ibio aniꞌe ḡonore azaḡa hidiro. Ze dabuaḡa fuhiꞌadu ḡauḡa niduꞌa meiro, zu bounadu nariga mau runiro, ebu eꞌea bazune mode feraro.
Eꞌe madaḡano dibuꞌo vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa eꞌe ibiḡano ovoiro. Ebu vaze eꞌe horonirotene, ibi genaḡano vitau onamiro.
Eꞌe teige, Levi mariga vazeḡa
ꞌahoga zuni eꞌe ibiḡano ovoadu vaze eꞌe horoniro, rehano ane zuni ibi genaḡano vitau onamiro.
Rehano Samaria vazeḡa ꞌahogaꞌe ragave onameꞌeteꞌea, eꞌe ibiḡano ovoadu vaze eꞌe horoniro ebu vetuḡani runiro.
Ebu ane vaḡe onamadu dehoro zu vaini vuḡa hina idiriḡa rana beuꞌadu ꞌumiro. Ebu ane doniki rana mae ohonadu iꞌudo neḡa tutune onamiro, zu eꞌea ani taufe radiro.
Irarirotene, aniꞌa hadi nu
madu iꞌudo neḡa vazeḡa hanadu niro, 'Ani taufe radoꞌi. Hadi ꞌahiꞌe mene idaḡa roꞌidene, eḡeꞌa baradu bare ḡaniꞌuma.'”
Iesuꞌa eꞌe hariḡa hauḡirotene, Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ḡadiniro, “Vaze uḡidu ꞌadi boꞌaḡano ḡae zamaroneꞌe iniuꞌe ḡonore azaḡa hidiroteꞌe vazeḡa nabuga?”
Aniꞌa naenaeniro, “Ani vetuḡaneadu dananiroteꞌe vazeḡa.” Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡa zuni onamadu ꞌouge haḡaoꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa Mareta zu Maria Ne Diuḡiro
Iesu zu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ragave onamadu ne ꞌahogano feuriro. Ebu roḡae ꞌahoga, niḡa Maretaꞌa neḡano Iesu mae zouniro.
Maretaꞌe negoḡeta zu niḡaꞌe Maria. Mariaꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boro oda babaḡano ehoradu nagini reiroteꞌe igi radiro.

U Maretaꞌe vaze ḡubuzoga veize gau ḡehaḡa haḡainuteꞌe uꞌano zamaḡaniꞌa adudaro. Eꞌanoꞌo ani Iesu vaḡe aradu niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, negoheꞌa eḡe daꞌo gaueꞌeteꞌe horohe tauḡeꞌohe. Ḡa eꞌe mene zamareꞌehe? Ani e danahoga veize noꞌi!”
Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa naenaeniro, “Mareta, Mareta, ḡaꞌe gau ḡehaḡa uꞌano zamaḡoꞌe aduduꞌohe zu maḡuneꞌohe.
Rehano gau boroꞌe tiba daꞌo, ebu Mariaꞌa gau eꞌe ohotiro. Eꞌanoꞌo vazeni ꞌahoga aniꞌa ꞌouge haḡaeꞌeteꞌe mene garariꞌuma.”
